proof.inputs: v3 unit binds direct parent audit revision (including empty), head and definition digests; manifest/2 binds exact direct parents and transitive metadata header census. Publication compares storage-derived actual inputs, never caller-selected citations.
proof.processing: Every actual parent is a processing edge; only nonempty output parents are support edges. Renderer preserves full nested blocks, conflicts, time and provenance, without new L1 facts or increased independent evidence.
proof.access: Full transitive metadata census, current reader/purpose, authority and external restore floor, all source grants/version/expiry pass before any parent revision/L0/L1 body. Child audience is an allowed subset; inherited sensitivity, retention and expiry cannot be relaxed.
proof.invalidation: Original writer UoW persists dirty descendants for candidates, interpretation/document, definition/query/authority/grants and parent publication. Current reads dynamically check the entire chain; queue waits for ready parents before claiming children, preserving finite target identity.
proof.erase: Shared closure follows every affected facet revision and configured subscriptions, physically tombstoning body/manifest/header/history and removing reverse edges. Actual SQLite backup and PostgreSQL pg_dump deletion-journal replay verify source, scope and derived-object erasure.
proof.compatibility: Legacy no-parent definitions/v1-v2 units serialize without new fields. Old publications lacking actual input headers require explicit full republish. Backends without processing-graph/1 neither advertise parents nor store new headers.

tests.real_sigkill_matrix: root publication + child publication, before/after commit, both backends; verifies fixed manifest/header/head/completion and descendant outbox atomicity
tests.accounting: Final targeted source run only; prior-stage scores and installed repeats are not counted.
tests.fixture_repair: New SQLite grant/publication race initially blocked its own shared event loop because synchronous BEGIN IMMEDIATE waited on the paused owner. Corrected to an independent thread/event loop, matching independent writer execution. PostgreSQL uses independent asynchronous connections; no production lock workaround.
